summary: The callback/ChatId runtime behavior is correct, but the exact requested two-commit result is not native-type clean. The new correlated union makes two focused backend test request helpers invalid at commit 2c57f1808.

counterexample.expected: The native TypeScript program accepts all focused inference tests after the request-contract change.
actual: TS2322 at tests/inference/backends/anthropic-messages/chat.test.ts:71: spreading Partial<AnthropicChatRequest> can produce an onDelta callback without a required chatId, so the result is not assignable to AnthropicChatRequest.

TS2322 at tests/inference/backends/openai-compat/chat.test.ts:59: spreading Partial<OpenAiCompatChatRequest> has the same invalid optional callback/identity pair and is not assignable to OpenAiCompatChatRequest.

confirmed_subclaims.type_boundary: ChatDeltaSubscription is a two-arm union: onDelta requires chatId: ChatId; the callback-free arm permits an optional chatId.
confirmed_subclaims.runtime_backstops: agent-sdk returns before emitting unless both chatId and onDelta exist; anthropic-messages and openai-compat construct deltaTarget only when both exist.
confirmed_subclaims.fabricated_identity_removed: The parent had exactly three castId<ChatId>(... ?? empty-string) sites in the three inference chat backends. Commit 2c57f1808 has none under packages/inference or tests/inference.
confirmed_subclaims.backend_narrowing: Both array-wire backend entry points use api-based type predicates and reject mismatched APIs with ProviderError instead of assertions.
confirmed_subclaims.chatless_no_delta_runtime: The focused hosted backend suites construct requests without chatId/onDelta and pass. The callback-free contract arm also accepts an optional chatId.
confirmed_subclaims.malformed_pair_runtime: The cross-wire conformance test removes chatId through Reflect while retaining onDelta; all three served chat wires suppress callback delivery and still return the truthful completed reply.

evidence.literal_sweep: rg across TS and TSX found inference producers plus the server compose/engine consumers; git grep at the parent found exactly the three removed empty ChatId casts and git grep at 2c57f1808 found zero in packages/inference and tests/inference.
